+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto (Multiview-AV) transformer.
+
+Same weights and layer stack as ``Cosmos3OmniTransformer``. Two things change
+inside the network. The GEN cross-attention runs the masked block-sparse
+multiview attention of ``cosmos3_simulation.multiview_attention`` (FlexAttention Triton or
+FlashAttention-4 kernels) whenever the pipeline hands over a ``MultiviewLayout``.
+And the GEN sequence is assembled from packed sensor items instead of one video
+clip: the WSM control cameras, the RGB target cameras, and on joint checkpoints
+the HD-map control and LiDAR target range maps, each patchified through its own
+input projection and sharing one temporal origin. Per-camera captions are
+encoded by separate causal UND passes so no caption attends another; their K/V
+are concatenated for the GEN layers. A learned rig identity (``rig_view_embed``)
+is added to every sensor token. The transformer also owns the request-local
+attention caches so 36 layers and every denoising step reuse one block mask and
+one set of padded q/k/v buffers.
+
+Ulysses sequence parallelism: every rank assembles the full GEN stream, keeps a
+contiguous shard of its tokens through the per-token layers, and around each
+attention call trades sequence for heads (all-to-all), so each rank runs the
+full-sequence masked attention for its slice of the heads; the velocity is
+all-gathered at the end. Caption K/V stay replicated and are sliced per rank.
+"""
+

+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from typing import Any

+)

+)

+    get_sp_parallel_rank,

+    get_ulysses_parallel_world_size,
+)

+)

+def pack_state(tensors: list[torch.Tensor] | tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Flatten sensor latents of independent geometry into one ``[B, N]`` state."""
+    return torch.cat([tensor.flatten(1) for tensor in tensors], dim=1)
+
+
+def unpack_state(
+    state: torch.Tensor, shapes: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+    sizes = [math.prod(shape) for shape in shapes]
+    if state.ndim != 2 or state.shape[1] != sum(sizes):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Packed Cosmos3 multiview state does not match the declared geometries: "
+            f"state={tuple(state.shape)}, shapes={list(shapes)}."
+        )
+    return tuple(
+        part.reshape(state.shape[0], *shape)
+        for part, shape in zip(state.split(sizes, dim=1), shapes, strict=True)
+    )
+
+
+def spatial_patch_hw(patch: int | Sequence[int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Normalize a square or ``(height, width)`` spatial patch size."""
+    sides = (patch, patch) if isinstance(patch, int) else tuple(patch)
+    if len(sides) != 2 or any(
+        isinstance(side, bool) or not isinstance(side, int) or side <= 0
+        for side in sides
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Spatial patch size must be a positive int or (height, width), got {patch!r}."
+        )
+    return sides  # type: ignore[return-value]
+
+
+def lidar_patch_grid(
+    height: int, width: int, patch_hw: tuple[int, int]
+) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    """``(patch_h, patch_w, padded_h, padded_w)`` of a latent zero-padded to its patch."""
+    ph, pw = patch_hw
+    patch_h, patch_w = math.ceil(height / ph), math.ceil(width / pw)
+    return patch_h, patch_w, patch_h * ph, patch_w * pw
+
+
+def patchify_lidar(latent: torch.Tensor, patch_hw: tuple[int, int]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``[B, C, T, H, W]`` range-map latents to ``[B, T*Hp*Wp, ph*pw*C]`` with edge padding."""
+    batch, channels, frames, height, width = latent.shape
+    ph, pw = patch_hw
+    patch_h, patch_w, padded_h, padded_w = lidar_patch_grid(height, width, patch_hw)
+    if (padded_h, padded_w) != (height, width):
+        latent = torch.nn.functional.pad(
+            latent, (0, padded_w - width, 0, padded_h - height)
+        )
+    x = latent.reshape(batch, channels, frames, patch_h, ph, patch_w, pw)
+    x = x.permute(0, 2, 3, 5, 4, 6, 1)
+    return x.reshape(batch, frames * patch_h * patch_w, ph * pw * channels)
+
+
+def unpatchify_lidar(
+    tokens: torch.Tensor, shape: Sequence[int], patch_hw: tuple[int, int]
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    channels, frames, height, width = (int(dim) for dim in shape)
+    ph, pw = patch_hw
+    patch_h, patch_w, padded_h, padded_w = lidar_patch_grid(height, width, patch_hw)
+    x = tokens.reshape(tokens.shape[0], frames, patch_h, patch_w, ph, pw, channels)
+    x = x.permute(0, 6, 1, 2, 4, 3, 5)
+    x = x.reshape(tokens.shape[0], channels, frames, padded_h, padded_w)
+    return x[:, :, :, :height, :width]
+
+
+def sequence_shard_padding(seq_len: int, world_size: int) -> int:
+    """Tokens appended so a sequence splits evenly over ``world_size`` ranks."""
+    if world_size <= 1:
+        return 0
+    return (-seq_len) % world_size
+
+
+def shard_sequence(
+    tensor: torch.Tensor, world_size: int, rank: int, *, dim: int, pad_last: bool
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """This rank's contiguous shard of ``tensor`` along ``dim``.
+
+    The sequence is first padded to a multiple of ``world_size`` by repeating the
+    last entry (``pad_last``, for positions) or with zeros (for tokens).
+    """
+    if world_size <= 1:
+        return tensor
+    pad = sequence_shard_padding(tensor.shape[dim], world_size)
+    if pad:
+        tail = tensor.narrow(dim, tensor.shape[dim] - 1, 1)
+        filler = tail.expand(*[pad if i == dim else -1 for i in range(tensor.ndim)])
+        if not pad_last:
+            filler = torch.zeros_like(filler)
+        tensor = torch.cat([tensor, filler], dim=dim)
+    local = tensor.shape[dim] // world_size
+    return tensor.narrow(dim, rank * local, local).contiguous()
+
+
+def add_rig_view_rows(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor, rows: torch.Tensor, num_views: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Add one rig-identity row to each camera-major view block of ``hidden`` in place.
+
+    ``hidden`` is ``[B, N, D]`` with the ``N`` tokens of an item ordered view by
+    view; ``rows`` is ``[num_views, D]``, or ``[1, D]`` for one row shared by every
+    token (LiDAR). The per-view blocks are broadcast views, so no ``[N, D]``
+    offset tensor is materialized.
+    """
+    batch, tokens, dim = hidden.shape
+    if rows.ndim != 2 or rows.shape[-1] != dim or rows.shape[0] not in (1, num_views):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Rig view embedding rows must be [1 or {num_views}, {dim}], got {tuple(rows.shape)}."
+        )
+    blocks = rows.shape[0]
+    if tokens % blocks:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{tokens} tokens cannot be split into {blocks} camera-major view blocks."
+        )
+    hidden.view(batch, blocks, tokens // blocks, dim).add_(
+        rows.to(hidden.dtype).view(1, blocks, 1, dim)
+    )
+    return hidden
+
+
+class Cosmos3MultiviewCrossAttention(Cosmos3CrossAttention):
+    """GEN cross-attention that runs the masked multiview attention."""
+
+    def _forward_multiview(
+        self,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,
+        k_und: torch.Tensor,
+        v_und: torch.Tensor,
+        multiview_layout: Any,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if not isinstance(multiview_layout, MultiviewAttentionContext):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "Cosmos3 multiview cross-attention expected MultiviewAttentionContext, "
+                f"got {type(multiview_layout).__name__}."
+            )
+        world_size = get_ulysses_parallel_world_size()
+        if world_size <= 1:
+            return padded_multiview_flex_attention(
+                q, k, v, k_und, v_und, multiview_layout
+            )
+        if get_ring_parallel_world_size() > 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Cosmos3 multiview attention supports Ulysses sequence parallelism "
+                "only; set ring_degree=1."
+            )
+        heads, kv_heads = q.shape[2], k.shape[2]
+        if heads % world_size or kv_heads % world_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Cosmos3 multiview Ulysses degree {world_size} must divide the "
+                f"{heads} query and {kv_heads} key/value heads."
+            )
+        # Sequence-sharded [B, S_local, H, D] -> head-sharded [B, S_padded, H/N, D].
+        q = _usp_input_all_to_all(q, head_dim=2)
+        k = _usp_input_all_to_all(k, head_dim=2)
+        v = _usp_input_all_to_all(v, head_dim=2)
+        padded_len = q.shape[1]
+        real_len = multiview_layout.layout.gen_tokens
+        rank = get_ulysses_parallel_rank()
+        kv_local = kv_heads // world_size
+        kv_slice = slice(rank * kv_local, (rank + 1) * kv_local)
+        out = padded_multiview_flex_attention(
+            q[:, :real_len],
+            k[:, :real_len],
+            v[:, :real_len],
+            k_und[:, :, kv_slice],
+            v_und[:, :, kv_slice],
+            multiview_layout,
+        )
+        if envs.SGLANG_DIFFUSION_DEBUG_COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_SP_CHECK:
+            self._check_sharded_attention(
+                q, k, v, k_und, v_und, multiview_layout, out, real_len, rank, world_size
+            )
+        if padded_len > real_len:
+            out = torch.nn.functional.pad(out, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, padded_len - real_len))
+        return _usp_output_all_to_all(out, head_dim=2)
+
+    # Debug aid (SGLANG_DIFFUSION_DEBUG_COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_SP_CHECK): the full-sequence
+    # attention for every head, sliced to this rank's heads, must equal the Ulysses
+    # result bitwise (same kernel, same tokens). Doubles the attention cost; run with
+    # the NCCL transport, since the check issues all-to-alls of its own.
+    def _check_sharded_attention(
+        self, q, k, v, k_und, v_und, context, out, real_len, rank, world_size
+    ) -> None:
+        head_local = q.shape[2]
+
+        def gather_full(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+            # Head-sharded [B, S_padded, H/N, D] -> full [B, S, H, D].
+            return sequence_model_parallel_all_gather(
+                _usp_output_all_to_all(x, head_dim=2), dim=1
+            )[:, :real_len]
+
+        # The caption K/V is replicated on every rank; use it as is.
+        full = padded_multiview_flex_attention(
+            gather_full(q), gather_full(k), gather_full(v), k_und, v_und, context
+        )
+        mine = full[:, :, rank * head_local : (rank + 1) * head_local]
+        diff = (mine.float() - out.float()).abs()
+        logger.info(
+            "Cosmos3 multiview SP check (rank %d/%d, %d/%d kv heads): "
+            "max|diff| %.3g, rel %.2e, identical=%s",
+            rank,
+            world_size,
+            k.shape[2],
+            k_und.shape[2],
+            diff.max().item(),
+            (diff.norm() / out.float().norm()).item(),
+            torch.equal(mine, out),
+        )
+
+
+class Cosmos3MultiviewTransformer(Cosmos3OmniTransformer):
+    """Cosmos3 Nano weights with packed sensor items and request-local attention caches."""
+
+    _cross_attention_cls = Cosmos3MultiviewCrossAttention
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Cosmos3VideoConfig,
+        hf_config: dict[str, Any],
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        backbone_type = (
+            hf_config.get("backbone_type") if isinstance(hf_config, dict) else None
+        )
+        if backbone_type != COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_BACKBONE_TYPE:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Cosmos3MultiviewTransformer requires transformer/config.json "
+                f"backbone_type={COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_BACKBONE_TYPE!r}, got {backbone_type!r}."
+            )
+        super().__init__(config, hf_config, quant_config)
+        deployment = parse_multiview_deployment_config(hf_config)
+        self.lidar_config: dict[str, Any] | None = deployment.lidar
+        self.lidar_patch_hw = spatial_patch_hw(
+            deployment.lidar_latent_patch_size_hw
+            if deployment.lidar_latent_patch_size_hw is not None
+            else self.latent_patch_size
+        )
+        if self.lidar_config is not None:
+            # Joint checkpoints project LiDAR range-map latents through their
+            # own input/output linears; the GEN stack is shared with cameras.
+            lidar_width = (
+                self.lidar_patch_hw[0]
+                * self.lidar_patch_hw[1]
+                * int(self.lidar_config["latent_channels"])
+            )
+            self.lidar_proj_in = ReplicatedLinear(
+                lidar_width,
+                self.hidden_size,
+                bias=True,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix="lidar_proj_in",
+            )
+            self.lidar_proj_out = ReplicatedLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                lidar_width,
+                bias=True,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix="lidar_proj_out",
+            )
+        # Physical rig identity: one trained row per MADS camera id plus a final
+        # LiDAR row, added to control and target tokens alike.
+        rig = deployment.rig_view_embedding
+        self.rig_view_embed = nn.Embedding(int(rig["num_embeddings"]), self.hidden_size)

+            return caches[0]

+            (
+                torch.cat([cache[layer][0] for cache in caches], dim=1),
+                torch.cat([cache[layer][1] for cache in caches], dim=1),
+            )
+            for layer in range(len(caches[0]))

+    def _packed_position_ids(
+        self,
+        items: tuple[MaskItem, ...],

+        text_origin: int,
+        fps: float,
+        lidar_fps: float | None,
+        lidar_temporal_compression_factor: int,
+        align_views: bool,

+        camera latent advances 1.0 temporal position and a 10 Hz sweep 0.75.

+"""Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto transformer.
+
+The weights are the Cosmos3 Nano multiview generator: the shared GEN stack,
+the LiDAR input/output projections and the rig-view embedding table. What
+changes is the GEN attention: every token of the current chunk takes one
+softmax over the keys the replay predicate admits from the current chunk, the
+KV ring of committed chunks and the per-camera caption documents, executed as
+one block-sparse FlexAttention call planned on the host
+(``cosmos3_simulation.sim_auto_attention``). Every forward returns the chunk's post-norm,
+post-RoPE K and raw V, which a clean refresh commits to the ring.
+"""

+class UlyssesGroup(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """The rank's place in the Ulysses group; head groups follow rank order."""
+
+    rank: int
+    world_size: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.world_size < 2 or not 0 <= self.rank < self.world_size:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid Ulysses rank {self.rank} of {self.world_size}.")
+
+    def local_heads(self, heads: int) -> int:
+        if heads % self.world_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{heads} heads are not divisible by the Ulysses degree {self.world_size}."
+            )
+        return heads // self.world_size
+
+    def head_slice(self, heads: int) -> slice:
+        """This rank's contiguous group of ``heads`` (TP-local) heads."""
+        size = self.local_heads(heads)
+        return slice(self.rank * size, (self.rank + 1) * size)
+
+    def shard(self, num_tokens: int) -> ChunkShard:
+        return ChunkShard(group=self, num_tokens=num_tokens)
+
+
+class ChunkShard(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """One forward's token split: ``ceil(num_tokens / U)`` tokens per rank, padded at the end."""
+
+    group: UlyssesGroup
+    num_tokens: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.num_tokens < 1:
+            raise ValueError("A Ulysses shard needs at least one token.")
+
+    @property
+    def local_tokens(self) -> int:
+        return -(-self.num_tokens // self.group.world_size)
+
+    @property
+    def padded_tokens(self) -> int:
+        return self.local_tokens * self.group.world_size
+
+    def split(self, tensor: torch.Tensor, *, dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """This rank's ``local_tokens`` along ``dim``; the padding repeats the last entry.
+
+        Repeating keeps RoPE positions valid; padded hidden rows never act as
+        keys and their outputs are dropped by :meth:`gather`.
+        """
+        if tensor.shape[dim] != self.num_tokens:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Expected {self.num_tokens} tokens to shard, got {tensor.shape[dim]}."
+            )
+        start = self.group.rank * self.local_tokens
+        padded = _pad_repeat_last(tensor, self.padded_tokens, dim=dim)
+        return padded.narrow(dim, start, self.local_tokens).contiguous()
+
+    def gather(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """All-gather ``[B, local_tokens, ...]`` shards into ``[B, num_tokens, ...]``."""
+        self._check_local(tensor)
+        gathered = sequence_model_parallel_all_gather(tensor.contiguous(), dim=1)
+        return gathered[:, : self.num_tokens]
+
+    def heads_from_tokens(
+        self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """``[B, local_tokens, H, D]`` Q/K/V -> ``[B, num_tokens, H / U, D]`` of this rank's head group.
+
+        Heads split into contiguous groups in rank order on both sides, so
+        query group ``r`` still reads KV group ``r``.
+        """
+        for tensor in (q, k, v):
+            self._check_local(tensor)
+        q, k, v = (
+            _usp_input_all_to_all(tensor, head_dim=2)[:, : self.num_tokens]
+            for tensor in (q, k, v)
+        )
+        return q, k, v
+
+    def tokens_from_heads(self, output: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``[B, num_tokens, H / U, D]`` attention output -> ``[B, local_tokens, H, D]``."""
+        if output.shape[1] != self.num_tokens:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Expected {self.num_tokens} attention rows, got {output.shape[1]}."
+            )
+        pad = self.padded_tokens - self.num_tokens
+        if pad:
+            output = torch.nn.functional.pad(output, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, pad))
+        return _usp_output_all_to_all(output, head_dim=2)
+
+    def _check_local(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        if tensor.shape[1] != self.local_tokens:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Expected {self.local_tokens} local tokens ({self.num_tokens} tokens / "
+                f"Ulysses {self.group.world_size}), got {tensor.shape[1]}."
+            )
+
+
+class SpCheck(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Debug tally (``SGLANG_DIFFUSION_DEBUG_COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_SP_CHECK``) over one forward's layers."""
+
+    layers: int = 0
+    identical: int = 0
+    max_diff: float = 0.0
+
+    def compare(
+        self,
+        shard: ChunkShard,
+        *,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        keys: torch.Tensor,
+        values: torch.Tensor,
+        mask: ReplayMask,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Full-head attention sliced to this rank's heads must equal ``out`` bitwise (same kernel, same tokens)."""
+        full = replay_attention(
+            _all_heads(q, shard.group),
+            _all_heads(keys, shard.group),
+            _all_heads(values, shard.group),
+            mask,
+        )
+        mine = full[:, :, shard.group.head_slice(full.shape[2])]
+        self.layers += 1
+        self.identical += int(torch.equal(mine, out))
+        self.max_diff = max(
+            self.max_diff, float((mine.float() - out.float()).abs().max())
+        )
+
+    def summary(self, group: UlyssesGroup) -> str:
+        return (
+            f"Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto SP check (rank {group.rank}/{group.world_size}): "
+            f"{self.identical}/{self.layers} layers bitwise identical to full-head attention, "
+            f"max|diff| {self.max_diff:.3g}"
+        )
+
+
+def _all_heads(tensor: torch.Tensor, group: UlyssesGroup) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``[B, S, h / U, D]`` of every rank concatenated into ``[B, S, h, D]`` (rank order = head order)."""
+    parts = [torch.empty_like(tensor) for _ in range(group.world_size)]
+    dist.all_gather(parts, tensor.contiguous(), group=get_sp_group().ulysses_group)
+    return torch.cat(parts, dim=2)
+
+
+def _pad_repeat_last(tensor: torch.Tensor, length: int, *, dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    pad = length - tensor.shape[dim]
+    if pad == 0:
+        return tensor
+    last = tensor.narrow(dim, tensor.shape[dim] - 1, 1)
+    return torch.cat([tensor, *([last] * pad)], dim=dim)
+
+
+def current_ulysses_group() -> UlyssesGroup | None:
+    """The worker's Ulysses group, or ``None`` at degree 1."""
+    world_size = get_ulysses_parallel_world_size()
+    if world_size <= 1:
+        return None
+    return UlyssesGroup(rank=get_ulysses_parallel_rank(), world_size=world_size)
+
+
+def local_head_group(
+    layer_kv: Sequence[KVPair], group: UlyssesGroup | None
+) -> list[KVPair]:
+    """The rank's head group of per-layer ``[1, tokens, H_kv, D]`` K/V (identity without Ulysses)."""
+    if group is None:
+        return list(layer_kv)
+    heads = group.head_slice(layer_kv[0][0].shape[2])
+    # Copies, so the full caption K/V is not kept alive by views.
+    return [
+        (key[:, :, heads].contiguous(), value[:, :, heads].contiguous())
+        for key, value in layer_kv
+    ]
+
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+KVPair = tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]
+
+
+class Cosmos3SimAutoForwardOutput(msgspec.Struct):
+    """Predictions of the target items (in item order) plus the chunk's per-layer ``[1, S, H_kv, D]`` K/V."""
+
+    targets: list[torch.Tensor]
+    current_kv: list[KVPair]
+
+
+def _replay_layer_attention(
+    attention: Cosmos3CrossAttention,
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    rope_positions: torch.Tensor,
+    history: KVPair,
+    captions: KVPair,
+    mask: ReplayMask,
+    shard: ChunkShard | None,
+    sp_check: SpCheck | None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """One softmax over ``[current | ring | captions]``; returns the output and the chunk's K/V.
+
+    With ``shard`` the hidden states, RoPE positions and output are the rank's
+    token shard, while the K/V streams and the returned K/V hold every token
+    for the rank's head group.
+    """
+    batch_size, seq_len = hidden.shape[:2]
+    num_q_heads = attention.local_num_attention_heads
+    num_kv_heads = attention.local_num_key_value_heads
+    qkv, _ = attention.to_qkv(hidden)
+    qkv = qkv.view(
+        batch_size, seq_len, num_q_heads + 2 * num_kv_heads, attention.head_dim
+    )
+    q = qkv[:, :, :num_q_heads]
+    k = qkv[:, :, num_q_heads : num_q_heads + num_kv_heads]
+    v = qkv[:, :, num_q_heads + num_kv_heads :]
+    q, k = _apply_qwen3_qk_norm_rope(
+        q,
+        k,
+        attention.norm_q,
+        attention.norm_k,
+        attention.head_dim,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        rope_positions,
+    )
+    if shard is not None:
+        q, k, v = shard.heads_from_tokens(q, k, v)
+    k = k.contiguous()
+    v = v.contiguous()
+    # Key order is the plan's stream order: current chunk, ring, captions.
+    keys = torch.cat([k, history[0], captions[0]], dim=1)
+    values = torch.cat([v, history[1], captions[1]], dim=1)
+    out = replay_attention(q, keys, values, mask)
+    if shard is not None:
+        if sp_check is not None:
+            sp_check.compare(shard, q=q, keys=keys, values=values, mask=mask, out=out)
+        out = shard.tokens_from_heads(out)
+    out, _ = attention.to_out(out.reshape(batch_size, seq_len, -1))
+    return out, k, v
+
+
+class Cosmos3SimAutoGenDecoderLayer(Cosmos3GenDecoderLayer):
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden: torch.Tensor, **attention_kwargs: Any
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        attention_output, k, v = _replay_layer_attention(
+            self.cross_attention, self.input_layernorm(hidden), **attention_kwargs
+        )
+        hidden = hidden + attention_output
+        return hidden + self.mlp(self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden)), k, v
+
+
+class Cosmos3SimAutoTransformer(Cosmos3OmniTransformer):
+    """Cosmos3 Nano multiview weights driven as a chunk-causal world model."""
+
+    _gen_layer_cls = Cosmos3SimAutoGenDecoderLayer
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Cosmos3VideoConfig,
+        hf_config: dict[str, Any],
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        backbone_type = hf_config.get("backbone_type")
+        if backbone_type != COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_BACKBONE_TYPE:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Cosmos3SimAutoTransformer requires transformer/config.json "
+                f"backbone_type={COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_BACKBONE_TYPE!r}, got {backbone_type!r}."
+            )
+        super().__init__(config=config, hf_config=hf_config, quant_config=quant_config)
+        self.manifest: Cosmos3SimAutoManifest = load_cosmos3_sim_auto_manifest(
+            hf_config
+        )
+        self._validate_causal_arch(hf_config)
+        manifest = self.manifest
+        self.lidar_patch_hw = spatial_patch_hw(
+            manifest.lidar_latent_patch_size_hw
+            if manifest.lidar_latent_patch_size_hw is not None
+            else self.latent_patch_size
+        )
+        if manifest.lidar is not None:
+            lidar_width = (
+                self.lidar_patch_hw[0]
+                * self.lidar_patch_hw[1]
+                * int(manifest.lidar["latent_channels"])
+            )
+            self.lidar_proj_in = ReplicatedLinear(
+                lidar_width,
+                self.hidden_size,
+                bias=True,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix="lidar_proj_in",
+            )
+            self.lidar_proj_out = ReplicatedLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                lidar_width,
+                bias=True,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix="lidar_proj_out",
+            )
+        rig = manifest.rig_view_embedding
+        self.rig_view_embed = nn.Embedding(int(rig["num_embeddings"]), self.hidden_size)
+        self.rig_lidar_id = int(rig["lidar_id"])
+        self.ulysses: UlyssesGroup | None = current_ulysses_group()
+        # A checkpoint without the rig table would run on random rows and no
+        # error; the loader turns the missing tensor into a hard failure.
+        self.rig_view_embed.weight.missing_param_init = "error"
+
+    def _validate_causal_arch(self, hf_config: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        expected_flags = {
+            "joint_attn_implementation": "multiview",
+            "video_temporal_causal": True,
+            "unified_3d_mrope_reset_spatial_ids": True,
+        }
+        for key, expected in expected_flags.items():
+            if hf_config.get(key) != expected:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Unsupported Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto transformer config: {key}={hf_config.get(key)!r}; "
+                    f"expected {expected!r}."
+                )
+        if self.sound_gen or self.config.action_gen:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto checkpoints carry no sound or action pathway."
+            )
+        manifest = self.manifest
+        mismatches = {
+            "temporal_compression_factor": (
+                self.temporal_compression_factor,
+                manifest.temporal_compression_factor,
+            ),
+            "latent_patch_size": (self.latent_patch_size, manifest.latent_patch_size),
+            "latent_channels": (self.latent_channel, manifest.latent_channels),
+            "temporal_modality_margin": (
+                self.temporal_margin,
+                manifest.temporal_modality_margin,
+            ),
+            "base_fps": (float(self.base_fps), float(manifest.base_fps)),
+        }
+        for name, (arch_value, manifest_value) in mismatches.items():
+            if arch_value != manifest_value:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto {name} differs between transformer config and artifact: "
+                    f"{arch_value} != {manifest_value}."
+                )
+
+    def lidar_patch_grid(self, height: int, width: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """LiDAR token grid ``(patch_h, patch_w)`` of a latent of this height and width."""
+        return lidar_patch_grid(height, width, self.lidar_patch_hw)[:2]
+
+    # -- captions ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def encode_caption(self, text_ids: torch.Tensor) -> list[KVPair]:
+        """One causal UND pass over a single caption document, positions rewound to zero."""
+        if text_ids.ndim != 2 or text_ids.shape[0] != 1 or text_ids.shape[1] < 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto captions must be [1, L] token ids, got {tuple(text_ids.shape)}."
+            )
+        positions, _ = compute_mrope_position_ids_text(
+            text_ids.shape[1], temporal_offset=0, device=text_ids.device
+        )
+        return self.language_model(
+            text_ids, torch.ones_like(text_ids), positions.unsqueeze(1)
+        )
+
+    # -- geometry --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def chunk_position_ids(
+        self, items: Sequence[StreamItem], *, text_extent: int, device: torch.device
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Absolute 3D mRoPE ids of the packed chunk, ``[3, S]`` float32.
+
+        Caption documents are rewound to ``0..len-1``, so media starts at
+        ``text_extent + temporal_modality_margin``. With FPS modulation a sensor
+        frame advances ``seconds_per_frame * base_fps / temporal_compression``
+        positions (1.0 per RGB latent at 30 fps, 0.75 per 10 Hz LiDAR sweep);
+        camera-major items repeat the temporal ids per view and spatial ids
+        restart at zero per frame.
+        """
+        offset = float(text_extent + self.temporal_margin)
+        parts = []
+        for item in items:
+            rate = (
+                item.seconds_per_frame
+                * float(self.base_fps)
+                / self.temporal_compression_factor
+            )
+            frames = torch.tensor(item.frames, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+            grid_h, grid_w = item.grid.grid_height, item.grid.grid_width
+            spatial = grid_h * grid_w
+            t_ids = (frames * rate + offset).view(-1, 1).expand(-1, spatial).reshape(-1)
+            h_ids = (
+                torch.arange(grid_h, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+                .view(-1, 1)
+                .expand(grid_h, grid_w)
+            )
+            w_ids = (
+                torch.arange(grid_w, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+                .view(1, -1)
+                .expand(grid_h, grid_w)
+            )
+            ids = torch.stack(
+                [
+                    t_ids,
+                    h_ids.reshape(-1).repeat(len(item.frames)),
+                    w_ids.reshape(-1).repeat(len(item.frames)),
+                ]
+            )
+            parts.append(ids.repeat(1, len(item.view_ids)))
+        return torch.cat(parts, dim=1)
+
+    # -- embedding -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def embed_items(
+        self,
+        items: Sequence[StreamItem],
+        latents: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        *,
+        timestep: torch.Tensor | None,
+        rig_view_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Project every item, add its rig identity, then the timestep to generated target frames only.
+
+        ``timestep`` is ``None`` for clean refresh forwards: controls, observed
+        condition frames and committed-clean targets never carry a time embed.
+        """
+        if len(items) != len(latents):
+            raise ValueError(f"{len(items)} items but {len(latents)} latent tensors.")
+        dtype = self.proj_in.weight.dtype
+        time_embed = None
+        if timestep is not None:
+            time_embed = (
+                self.time_embedder(timestep.reshape(1).float()).to(dtype).view(1, 1, -1)
+            )
+        camera_rows = self.rig_view_embed.weight[
+            rig_view_ids.to(self.rig_view_embed.weight.device)
+        ]
+        lidar_row = self.rig_view_embed.weight[self.rig_lidar_id].unsqueeze(0)
+        embeddings = []
+        for item, latent in zip(items, latents, strict=True):
+            expected_frames = len(item.view_ids) * len(item.frames)
+            if (
+                latent.ndim != 5
+                or latent.shape[0] != 1
+                or latent.shape[2] != expected_frames
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Item {item.kind} latents must be [1, C, {expected_frames}, H, W] (camera-major), "
+                    f"got {tuple(latent.shape)}."
+                )
+            if item.is_lidar:
+                hidden, _ = self.lidar_proj_in(
+                    patchify_lidar(latent.to(dtype), self.lidar_patch_hw)
+                )
+                rows = lidar_row
+            else:
+                hidden, _ = self.proj_in(
+                    self.patchify(latent.to(dtype), *latent.shape[2:])
+                )
+                if camera_rows.shape[0] != len(item.view_ids):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"{camera_rows.shape[0]} rig view ids for a {len(item.view_ids)}-camera {item.kind} item."
+                    )
+                rows = camera_rows
+            if hidden.shape[1] != item.num_tokens:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Item {item.kind} produced {hidden.shape[1]} tokens, layout expects {item.num_tokens}."
+                )
+            hidden = add_rig_view_rows(hidden, rows, len(item.view_ids))
+            if time_embed is not None and not item.is_control:
+                generated = torch.tensor(
+                    [frame not in item.condition_frames for frame in item.frames],
+                    dtype=torch.bool,
+                    device=hidden.device,
+                )
+                mask = generated.repeat(len(item.view_ids)).repeat_interleave(
+                    item.tokens_per_frame
+                )
+                hidden = hidden + time_embed * mask.view(1, -1, 1).to(dtype)
+            embeddings.append(hidden)
+        return torch.cat(embeddings, dim=1)
+
+    # -- forward -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        *,
+        items: Sequence[StreamItem],
+        latents: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        timestep: torch.Tensor | None,
+        text_extent: int,
+        und_kv: Sequence[KVPair],
+        history_kv: Sequence[KVPair],
+        mask: ReplayMask,
+        rig_view_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> Cosmos3SimAutoForwardOutput:
+        """Denoise (``timestep`` set) or clean-refresh (``timestep`` None) one chunk.
+
+        ``und_kv`` holds the per-layer caption K/V ``[1, U, H_kv, D]`` and
+        ``history_kv`` the per-layer ring K/V ``[1, R, H_kv, D]`` over the whole
+        ring capacity; the plan behind ``mask`` decides which of their
+        tokens a query may read. Under Ulysses every K/V argument and result
+        holds the rank's head group for every token; only the GEN layers run
+        on a token shard.
+        """
+        if (
+            len(und_kv) != self.num_hidden_layers
+            or len(history_kv) != self.num_hidden_layers
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto expects {self.num_hidden_layers} caption and history KV layers, "
+                f"got {len(und_kv)} and {len(history_kv)}."
+            )
+        if timestep is not None and timestep.numel() != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"timestep must hold one value, got {tuple(timestep.shape)}."
+            )
+        hidden = self.embed_items(
+            items, latents, timestep=timestep, rig_view_ids=rig_view_ids
+        )
+        position_ids = self.chunk_position_ids(
+            items, text_extent=text_extent, device=hidden.device
+        )
+        cos_sin_cache, rope_positions = (
+            self.language_model.rotary_emb.build_rope_cache_inputs(
+                position_ids.unsqueeze(1), cache_dtype=hidden.dtype
+            )
+        )
+        shard = None if self.ulysses is None else self.ulysses.shard(hidden.shape[1])
+        sp_check = None
+        if shard is not None:
+            hidden = shard.split(hidden, dim=1)
+            rope_positions = shard.split(rope_positions, dim=0)
+            if envs.SGLANG_DIFFUSION_DEBUG_COSMOS3_MULTIVIEW_SP_CHECK:
+                sp_check = SpCheck()
+        current_kv: list[KVPair] = []
+        for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(self.gen_layers):
+            hidden, k, v = layer(
+                hidden,
+                cos_sin_cache=cos_sin_cache,
+                rope_positions=rope_positions,
+                history=history_kv[layer_idx],
+                captions=und_kv[layer_idx],
+                mask=mask,
+                shard=shard,
+                sp_check=sp_check,
+            )
+            current_kv.append((k, v))
+        if shard is not None:
+            hidden = shard.gather(hidden)
+            if sp_check is not None:
+                logger.info(sp_check.summary(shard.group))
+        hidden = self.norm_moe_gen(hidden)
+        outputs = []
+        parts = hidden.split([item.num_tokens for item in items], dim=1)
+        for item, latent, part in zip(items, latents, parts, strict=True):
+            if item.is_control:
+                continue
+            if item.is_lidar:
+                projected, _ = self.lidar_proj_out(part)
+                outputs.append(
+                    unpatchify_lidar(projected, latent.shape[1:], self.lidar_patch_hw)
+                )
+            else:
+                projected, _ = self.proj_out(part)
+                outputs.append(self.unpatchify(projected, *latent.shape[2:]))
+        return Cosmos3SimAutoForwardOutput(targets=outputs, current_kv=current_kv)
+
+
+EntryClass = Cosmos3SimAutoTransformer

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Masked multiview attention for the Cosmos3 Multiview-AV variant.
+
+Inference-only implementation of the Multiview-AV visibility rules on top of
+the public PyTorch FlexAttention API, with an optional FlashAttention-4 CuTe
+backend (see ``multiview_fa4.py``). Ported from the vLLM-Omni reference
+implementation; the training code is a behavioral oracle, not a source. One
+mask that counts every permitted key once, on either kernel.
+
+Every GEN token carries six fields: sample, frame, view, control-or-RGB,
+text-or-vision, timestamp. Under the ``decomposed`` scope this checkpoint
+family uses:
+
+* every GEN query sees the real text (UND) keys of its sample: all of them
+  for a sample-level caption (``view_id == -1``), only its own camera's caption
+  when the checkpoint tokenizes one caption per camera, and every caption for a
+  LiDAR query (``view_id == -2``), which is not scoped to one camera;
+* sensor (RGB or LiDAR target) queries see sensor keys of the same view at any
+  frame and of every view at the same frame, or, with
+  ``decomposed_temporal_window_seconds``, of every view captured within that
+  many seconds *before* the query (past-only, same instant included), which is
+  what registers a 10 Hz LiDAR sweep against 7.5 Hz camera latents;
+* sensor queries see control (WSM or HD-map) keys of the same view only;
+* control queries see control keys of the same view only, plus sensor keys of
+  the same view when ``control_attends_sensor`` is set;
+* padding is isolated through a ``sample_id == -1`` sentinel.
+
+The mask is never materialized per token pair. Tokens are grouped into
+semantic runs, the predicate is evaluated once per run pair, and the result is
+projected onto the sparse block grid the attention kernel consumes.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Callable, MutableMapping, Sequence
+from typing import Any
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import BlockMask
+from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import flex_attention as torch_flex_attention
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.cosmos3_simulation.multiview_layout import (
+    AttentionScope,
+    MaskItem,
+    MultiviewAttentionContext,
+    MultiviewLayout,
+    _validate_attention_scope,
+    _validate_temporal_window,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.logging_utils import init_logger
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+SPARSE_Q_BLOCK_SIZE = 64
+SPARSE_KV_BLOCK_SIZE = 64
+
+# The default SM100 BF16/FP16 head_dim=128 FlexAttention configuration is
+# 128x64 with three stages and eight warps. The multiview mask_mod adds enough
+# state that the default first exceeded shared-memory capacity and, after only
+# shrinking BLOCK_N, produced an illegal access at launch. Use the smallest
+# square tile supported by the forward autotuner, remove software pipelining,
+# and keep TMA disabled. Aligning the sparse mask blocks with the compute tile
+# also avoids sub-block address arithmetic in the generated kernel.
+TRITON_Q_BLOCK_SIZE = 64
+TRITON_KV_BLOCK_SIZE = 64
+TRITON_NUM_STAGES = 1
+TRITON_NUM_WARPS = 4
+
+TRITON_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZES = (SPARSE_Q_BLOCK_SIZE, SPARSE_KV_BLOCK_SIZE)
+
+# FlashAttention-4 runs a 128x128 forward tile for head_dim 128 on both Hopper
+# and Blackwell. SM100 stages two Q tiles per CTA whenever the query length
+# exceeds one tile, so its sparse map must be (2 * tile_m, tile_n) = (256, 128);
+# SM90 stages one, so (128, 128). The kernel derives these from its own
+# heuristic and rejects metadata that disagrees. SM120 (consumer Blackwell) has
+# no block-sparse forward kernel. See flash_attn/cute/interface.py and
+# flash_attn/cute/block_sparsity.py::infer_block_sparse_expected_shapes.
+FA4_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZES_BY_CAPABILITY: dict[int, tuple[int, int]] = {
+    9: (128, 128),
+    10: (256, 128),
+    11: (256, 128),
+}
+
+
+def fa4_sparse_block_sizes(
+    device: torch.device | None = None, *, capability_major: int | None = None
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """The ``(q, kv)`` sparse block map FlashAttention-4 demands on a device."""
+    if capability_major is None:
+        if device is None or device.type != "cuda":
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Cosmos3 multiview FA4 block geometry follows the CUDA device's compute "
+                "capability; pass a CUDA device or set MultiviewLayout.fa4_block_sizes."
+            )
+        capability_major = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)[0]
+    sizes = FA4_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZES_BY_CAPABILITY.get(capability_major)
+    if sizes is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "FlashAttention-4 block-sparse attention is not available on compute "
+            f"capability {capability_major}.x; supported: SM90 (Hopper) and SM100 "
+            "(Blackwell). Use backend='triton' on this device."
+        )
+    return sizes
+
+
+def fa4_sparse_available(device: torch.device | None = None) -> bool:
+    """Whether the FA4 CuTe block-sparse kernels can run here (package and SM)."""
+    if device is None:
+        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+            return False
+        device = torch.device("cuda")
+    if device.type != "cuda":
+        return False
+    if (
+        torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)[0]
+        not in FA4_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZES_BY_CAPABILITY
+    ):
+        return False
+    try:
+        import cutlass  # noqa: F401
+        import flash_attn.cute  # noqa: F401
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        logger.debug(
+            "Cosmos3 FA4 unavailable; falling back to Triton: %s", exc, exc_info=True
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def resolve_masked_backend(device: torch.device | None = None) -> str:
+    """The masked-family kernel for ``device``: FA4 block-sparse where its kernels run
+    (SM90 Hopper, SM100 Blackwell, with the flash-attn CuTe package), else Triton.
+
+    Hopper joined the default on Oct 2 2026 after the H200 A/B: both kernels at
+    bf16 rounding from the dense oracle, FA4 2x faster per call.
+    """
+    if device is None and torch.cuda.is_available():
+        device = torch.device("cuda")
+    if device is not None and device.type == "cuda" and fa4_sparse_available(device):
+        return "fa4"
+    return "triton"
+
+
+def layout_sparse_block_sizes(
+    layout: MultiviewLayout, device: torch.device
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """The ``(q, kv)`` sparse block granularity this layout's backend demands on ``device``."""
+    if layout.backend == "triton":
+        return TRITON_SPARSE_BLOCK_SIZES
+    if layout.backend != "fa4":
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Cosmos3 multiview backend {layout.backend!r} has no sparse block map; "
+            "the kernels are 'triton' and 'fa4'."
+        )
+    if layout.fa4_block_sizes is not None:
+        return layout.fa4_block_sizes
+    return fa4_sparse_block_sizes(device)

+# eq=False: tensor fields make a generated __eq__ return a tensor.
+class MultiviewFlexMetadata(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, eq=False):
+    """Per-token metadata for rectangular GEN-to-[UND|GEN] attention."""
+
+    sample_id: torch.Tensor
+    frame_id: torch.Tensor
+    view_id: torch.Tensor
+    is_control: torch.Tensor
+    is_und: torch.Tensor
+    timestamp: torch.Tensor

+    attention_scope: AttentionScope
+    decomposed_temporal_window_seconds: float | None = None

+    @property

+
+        Timestamp is excluded: under the validated single-rate camera layout it
+        is a function of ``(view_id, frame_id)``.
+        """

+class PaddedAttentionGeometry(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    real_q_len: int
+    padded_q_len: int
+    real_und_len: int
+    padded_und_len: int

+
+def build_multiview_flex_metadata(
+    seq_len: int,
+    full_q_offsets: Sequence[int],
+    items_per_sample: Sequence[Sequence[MaskItem]] | Sequence[MaskItem],
+    device: torch.device | str,
+    num_und: int,
+    attention_scope: AttentionScope = "decomposed",
+    decomposed_temporal_window_seconds: float | None = None,
+    control_attends_sensor: bool = False,
+    caption_lengths: Sequence[int] = (),
+    lidar_attends_captions: bool = True,
+) -> MultiviewFlexMetadata:
+    """Build per-token metadata without materializing a dense mask.
+
+    ``full_q_offsets`` contains the start of every packed vision item plus the
+    end of the final item. The first offset is also the query start and may be
+    larger than ``num_und`` because UND is padded independently.
+
+    ``caption_lengths`` partitions the real text tokens into one caption per
+    camera view (in view order); a UND token's ``view_id`` then names the view
+    its caption describes. Empty keeps the sample-level caption (``-1``).
+    """
+    attention_scope = _validate_attention_scope(attention_scope)
+    _validate_temporal_window(decomposed_temporal_window_seconds)
+    if not isinstance(control_attends_sensor, bool):
+        raise TypeError("Cosmos3 multiview control_attends_sensor must be boolean.")
+    if not isinstance(lidar_attends_captions, bool):
+        raise TypeError("Cosmos3 multiview lidar_attends_captions must be boolean.")
+    device = torch.device(device)
+    if seq_len <= 0 or num_und < 0 or num_und > seq_len:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Invalid Cosmos3 multiview sequence geometry: seq_len={seq_len}, num_und={num_und}."
+        )
+    if items_per_sample and isinstance(items_per_sample[0], MaskItem):  # type: ignore[index]
+        samples: list[list[MaskItem]] = [list(items_per_sample)]  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    else:
+        samples = [list(items) for items in items_per_sample]  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    if len(samples) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 multiview v1 supports exactly one sample per request."
+        )
+    items = samples[0]
+    if not items:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 multiview metadata requires at least one vision item."
+        )
+    if len(full_q_offsets) != len(items) + 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 multiview full_q_offsets must contain one boundary per item plus "
+            f"the end: offsets={list(full_q_offsets)}, items={len(items)}."
+        )
+    offsets = tuple(int(offset) for offset in full_q_offsets)
+    if (
+        offsets[0] < num_und
+        or offsets[-1] > seq_len
+        or any(a > b for a, b in zip(offsets, offsets[1:]))
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Invalid Cosmos3 multiview item offsets: {offsets} for seq_len={seq_len}."
+        )
+
+    sample_id = torch.full((seq_len,), -1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    frame_id = torch.full_like(sample_id, -1)
+    view_id = torch.full_like(sample_id, -1)
+    is_control = torch.zeros(seq_len, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+    is_und = torch.zeros_like(is_control)
+    timestamp = torch.full((seq_len,), -1.0, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    sample_id[:num_und] = 0
+    is_und[:num_und] = True
+    if caption_lengths:
+        if sum(caption_lengths) != num_und or any(
+            length <= 0 for length in caption_lengths
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Cosmos3 multiview caption_lengths must partition the real text tokens: "
+                f"lengths={list(caption_lengths)}, num_und={num_und}."
+            )
+        start = 0
+        for view, length in enumerate(caption_lengths):
+            view_id[start : start + length] = view
+            start += length
+
+    view_offsets = {item.view_offset for item in items}
+    if (
+        attention_scope == "decomposed"
+        and len(view_offsets) > 1
+        and decomposed_temporal_window_seconds is None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 decomposed attention does not support mixed view offsets "
+            "without a temporal window."
+        )
+
+    rates_by_view_offset: dict[int, float] = {}
+    for item in items:
+        expected = rates_by_view_offset.setdefault(
+            item.view_offset, item.seconds_per_frame
+        )
+        if not math.isclose(item.seconds_per_frame, expected):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Cosmos3 multiview items sharing a view offset must use the same "
+                f"seconds_per_frame: offset={item.view_offset}, got "
+                f"{item.seconds_per_frame}, expected {expected}."
+            )
+
+    for item_index, (item, start, end) in enumerate(
+        zip(items, offsets[:-1], offsets[1:], strict=True)
+    ):
+        if end - start != item.num_tokens:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Cosmos3 multiview item {item_index} occupies {end - start} tokens, "
+                f"expected {item.num_tokens}."
+            )
+        latent_t, patch_h, patch_w = item.token_shape
+        spatial_tokens = patch_h * patch_w
+        frames_per_view = latent_t // item.num_views
+        item_frames = torch.arange(frames_per_view, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        item_frames = item_frames.repeat(item.num_views).repeat_interleave(
+            spatial_tokens
+        )
+        item_views = torch.arange(
+            item.view_offset,
+            item.view_offset + item.num_views,
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=device,
+        ).repeat_interleave(frames_per_view * spatial_tokens)
+        item_timestamps = item_frames.to(torch.float32) * item.seconds_per_frame
+        sample_id[start:end] = 0
+        frame_id[start:end] = item_frames
+        # LiDAR keeps the six-vector ABI: one negative id shared by its control
+        # and target items, distinct from every camera view and from the
+        # sample-level caption sentinel.
+        view_id[start:end] = -2 if item.is_lidar else item_views
+        is_control[start:end] = item.is_control
+        timestamp[start:end] = item_timestamps
+
+    return MultiviewFlexMetadata(
+        sample_id=sample_id,
+        frame_id=frame_id,
+        view_id=view_id,
+        is_control=is_control,
+        is_und=is_und,
+        timestamp=timestamp,
+        query_start=offsets[0],
+        attention_scope=attention_scope,
+        decomposed_temporal_window_seconds=decomposed_temporal_window_seconds,
+        control_attends_sensor=control_attends_sensor,
+        lidar_attends_captions=lidar_attends_captions,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_pair_allowed(
+    q_vectors: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+    k_vectors: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+    attention_scope: AttentionScope,
+    decomposed_temporal_window_seconds: float | None,
+    control_attends_sensor: bool,
+    lidar_attends_captions: bool = True,
+) -> Callable[[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor]:
+    """Build the exact pair predicate with tensor-only traced configuration.
+
+    The returned closure is stored on Triton's ``BlockMask`` and traced by
+    Inductor. Scalar options are materialized here, outside that closure, so
+    Python strings, booleans, and floats cannot become dynamic captured
+    scalars. The FA4 path uses the same closure eagerly to build its packed run
+    table.
+    """
+    device = q_vectors[2].device
+    reaches_every_view = torch.tensor(attention_scope == "all_views", device=device)
+    is_decomposed = torch.tensor(attention_scope == "decomposed", device=device)
+    control_reaches_sensor = torch.tensor(control_attends_sensor, device=device)
+    lidar_reads_captions = torch.tensor(lidar_attends_captions, device=device)
+    has_temporal_window = torch.tensor(
+        decomposed_temporal_window_seconds is not None, device=device
+    )
+    temporal_window = torch.tensor(
+        0.0
+        if decomposed_temporal_window_seconds is None
+        else decomposed_temporal_window_seconds,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    temporal_window_eps = torch.tensor(1e-4, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+
+    def pair_allowed(q_index: torch.Tensor, kv_index: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        q_sample = q_vectors[0][q_index]
+        q_frame = q_vectors[1][q_index]
+        q_view = q_vectors[2][q_index]
+        q_control = q_vectors[3][q_index]
+        q_timestamp = q_vectors[5][q_index]
+        k_sample = k_vectors[0][kv_index]
+        k_frame = k_vectors[1][kv_index]
+        k_view = k_vectors[2][kv_index]
+        k_control = k_vectors[3][kv_index]
+        k_und = k_vectors[4][kv_index]
+        k_timestamp = k_vectors[5][kv_index]
+
+        # Sentinel equality isolates padding from real tokens while giving
+        # every padded query at least one padded key.
+        same_sample = q_sample == k_sample
+        same_view = q_view == k_view
+        same_frame = q_frame == k_frame
+        # Past-only capture-time window: a key captured at or before the query,
+        # no more than ``temporal_window`` seconds earlier (the reference's
+        # (-window, 0) bounds).
+        timestamp_gap = q_timestamp - k_timestamp
+        within_temporal_window = (timestamp_gap >= -temporal_window_eps) & (
+            timestamp_gap <= temporal_window + temporal_window_eps
+        )
+        reaches_own_instant = is_decomposed & torch.where(
+            has_temporal_window, within_temporal_window, same_frame
+        )
+        in_scope = reaches_every_view | same_view | reaches_own_instant
+
+        # A UND key's view_id names the view its caption describes: -1 is the
+        # sample-level caption every query reads, a camera reads its own
+        # caption, and a LiDAR query (view -2) reads all of them.
+        reads_caption = k_und & ((k_view == -1) | (q_view == -2) | same_view)
+        # A LiDAR query (view -2) is cut off from every caption when the
+        # checkpoint trained it without text (lidar_attends_captions false).
+        reads_caption = reads_caption & ((q_view != -2) | lidar_reads_captions)
+        # ``~k_und`` keeps reads_caption the only term admitting a UND key;
+        # otherwise a per-view caption would reach every view under all_views.
+        sensor_to_sensor = (~q_control) & (~k_control) & (~k_und) & in_scope
+        sensor_to_control = (~q_control) & k_control & same_view
+        control_to_control = q_control & k_control & same_view
+        control_to_sensor = (
+            control_reaches_sensor & q_control & (~k_control) & (~k_und) & same_view
+        )
+        return same_sample & (
+            reads_caption
+            | sensor_to_sensor
+            | sensor_to_control
+            | control_to_control
+            | control_to_sensor
+        )
+
+    return pair_allowed
+
+
+def multiview_pair_predicate(
+    metadata: MultiviewFlexMetadata,
+    q_index: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_index: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Evaluate the exact token visibility predicate (also used as mask_mod)."""
+    pair_allowed = _make_pair_allowed(
+        metadata.query_vectors(),
+        metadata.key_vectors(),
+        metadata.attention_scope,
+        metadata.decomposed_temporal_window_seconds,
+        metadata.control_attends_sensor,
+        metadata.lidar_attends_captions,
+    )
+    return pair_allowed(q_index, kv_index)
+
+
+def _semantic_groups(
+    vectors: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return run IDs and first-token indexes without converting field dtypes."""
+    if not vectors:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 multiview semantic grouping requires at least one field."
+        )
+    seq_len = vectors[0].numel()
+    if any(vector.numel() != seq_len for vector in vectors):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 multiview semantic grouping fields must have equal lengths."
+        )
+    changed = torch.zeros(seq_len, dtype=torch.bool, device=vectors[0].device)
+    changed[:1] = True
+    for vector in vectors:
+        changed[1:] |= vector[1:] != vector[:-1]
+    group_ids = changed.to(torch.int64).cumsum(0) - 1
+    representatives = torch.nonzero(changed, as_tuple=False).flatten()
+    return group_ids, representatives
+
+
+def _block_group_presence(
+    group_ids: torch.Tensor, block_size: int, num_groups: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if group_ids.numel() % block_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Cosmos3 multiview metadata length {group_ids.numel()} is not aligned "
+            f"to block size {block_size}."
+        )
+    blocks = group_ids.view(-1, block_size)
+    presence = torch.zeros(
+        (blocks.shape[0], num_groups), dtype=torch.bool, device=group_ids.device
+    )
+    presence.scatter_(1, blocks, True)
+    return presence
+
+
+def _block_indices(mask: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    # Keep the full KV-block width instead of trimming to the densest row.
+    # ``create_block_mask`` always produces full-width contiguous indices and
+    # both the Triton template and ``BlockMask`` helpers assume that layout
+    # (see pytorch/pytorch#153344). Full width also keeps the mask shapes
+    # identical across CFG branches, so both share one compiled kernel.
+    counts = mask.sum(dim=-1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    indices = torch.argsort(mask.to(torch.int8), dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)
+    return counts, indices.to(torch.int32)
+
+
+def pack_allowed_bits(group_allowed: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
+    """Pack the ``[q_group, k_group]`` truth table into int32 bit words.
+
+    Bit ``g_k`` of word ``g_q * words_per_row + g_k // 32`` is the answer for
+    that group pair. Words hold the unsigned 32-bit pattern stored in ``int32``,
+    which is what the CuTe kernel reinterprets.
+    """
+    num_q_groups, num_k_groups = group_allowed.shape
+    words_per_row = (num_k_groups + 31) // 32
+    padded = group_allowed.new_zeros((num_q_groups, words_per_row * 32))
+    padded[:, :num_k_groups] = group_allowed
+    weights = torch.arange(32, device=group_allowed.device, dtype=torch.int64)
+    words = (
+        padded.view(num_q_groups, words_per_row, 32).to(torch.int64) << weights
+    ).sum(-1)
+    words = torch.where(words >= 2**31, words - 2**32, words)
+    return words.reshape(-1).to(torch.int32).contiguous(), words_per_row
+
+
+# eq=False: the fields are tensors, so a generated __eq__ would return a tensor
+# rather than a bool. Instances are cache values compared by identity.
+class MultiviewBlockSparsity(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, eq=False):
+    """Backend-neutral sparse block map plus the run-compressed mask table.
+
+    ``partial_*``/``full_*`` are the FlexAttention KV-block layout, which
+    FlashAttention-4 consumes unchanged. The remaining fields are the exact
+    per-element fallback used inside partially masked tiles: a token-to-run id
+    for each side plus the packed truth table over run pairs.
+    """
+
+    partial_counts: torch.Tensor
+    partial_indices: torch.Tensor
+    full_counts: torch.Tensor
+    full_indices: torch.Tensor
+    q_word_base: torch.Tensor
+    k_group_ids: torch.Tensor
+    allowed_words: torch.Tensor
+    group_allowed: torch.Tensor
+    words_per_row: int
+    q_block_size: int
+    kv_block_size: int
+    metadata: MultiviewFlexMetadata
+
+    @property
+    def q_len(self) -> int:
+        return self.metadata.q_len
+
+    @property
+    def kv_len(self) -> int:
+        return self.metadata.kv_len
+
+    def aux_tensors(self) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        """The mask_mod auxiliary tensors, in the order the kernel indexes them."""
+        return [self.q_word_base, self.k_group_ids, self.allowed_words]
+
+    def to_block_mask(self) -> BlockMask:
+        metadata = self.metadata
+        pair_allowed = _make_pair_allowed(
+            metadata.query_vectors(),
+            metadata.key_vectors(),
+            metadata.attention_scope,
+            metadata.decomposed_temporal_window_seconds,
+            metadata.control_attends_sensor,
+            metadata.lidar_attends_captions,
+        )
+
+        def mask_mod(
+            batch: torch.Tensor,
+            head: torch.Tensor,
+            q_idx: torch.Tensor,
+            kv_idx: torch.Tensor,
+        ) -> torch.Tensor:
+            del batch, head
+            return pair_allowed(q_idx, kv_idx)
+
+        return BlockMask.from_kv_blocks(
+            self.partial_counts[None, None],
+            self.partial_indices[None, None],
+            self.full_counts[None, None],
+            self.full_indices[None, None],
+            BLOCK_SIZE=(self.q_block_size, self.kv_block_size),
+            mask_mod=mask_mod,
+            seq_lengths=(metadata.q_len, metadata.kv_len),
+            compute_q_blocks=False,
+        )
+
+
+def build_multiview_block_sparsity(
+    metadata: MultiviewFlexMetadata,
+    *,
+    q_block_size: int = SPARSE_Q_BLOCK_SIZE,
+    kv_block_size: int = SPARSE_KV_BLOCK_SIZE,
+) -> MultiviewBlockSparsity:
+    """Compress semantic runs into a sparse block map and a mask lookup table.
+
+    The projection works at semantic-run and sparse-block granularity. Its
+    largest dense intermediates are block-grid sized (about 10.4M entries for
+    the released 11-view geometry at 64x64), never the ~42B-pair dense mask.
+    """
+    q_vectors = metadata.query_vectors()
+    k_vectors = metadata.key_vectors()
+    q_group_ids, q_representatives = _semantic_groups(metadata.query_grouping_vectors())
+    k_group_ids, k_representatives = _semantic_groups(metadata.key_grouping_vectors())
+
+    pair_allowed = _make_pair_allowed(
+        q_vectors,
+        k_vectors,
+        metadata.attention_scope,
+        metadata.decomposed_temporal_window_seconds,
+        metadata.control_attends_sensor,
+        metadata.lidar_attends_captions,
+    )
+    group_allowed = pair_allowed(q_representatives[:, None], k_representatives[None, :])
+    q_presence = _block_group_presence(
+        q_group_ids, q_block_size, q_representatives.numel()
+    )
+    k_presence = _block_group_presence(
+        k_group_ids, kv_block_size, k_representatives.numel()
+    )
+
+    # Float16 represents these tiny integer overlap counts exactly and gives a
+    # fast tensor-core projection on CUDA. CPU uses float32 matmul.
+    projection_dtype = (
+        torch.float16 if q_presence.device.type == "cuda" else torch.float32
+    )
+    q_projection = q_presence.to(projection_dtype)
+    k_projection = k_presence.to(projection_dtype)
+    visible_blocks = (

+
+FA4 expresses a sparse mask the same way FlexAttention does: a block map that
+classifies every (q_tile, kv_tile) as skipped, full, or partial, plus a
+``mask_mod`` that resolves individual pairs inside partial tiles. The block maps
+this module hands over are the ones the model modules already build (the
+Transfer-Auto multiview map of ``build_multiview_block_sparsity`` and the
+Sim-Auto replay map of ``build_replay_fa4_mask``); only the ``mask_mod`` is
+new, because FA4 compiles CuTe DSL rather than tracing Python.
+
+Rather than re-implement the visibility algebra in CuTe, the kernel reads a
+truth table that the host already computed over semantic runs. Every token
+carries the id of its run; the answer for a pair is one bit at
+``(q_run, k_run)``. The rules stay in Python, and this kernel never learns what
+a view or a frame is.
+

+Hopper/Blackwell-only dependency, and the multiview module must stay importable on
+CPU-only hosts.

+_OP_NAMESPACE = "sglang_diffusion"
+_OP_NAME = "cosmos3_multiview_fa4"

+# eq=False: the fields are tensors, so a generated __eq__ would return a tensor
+# rather than a bool. Instances are cache values compared by identity.

+    """Block map and packed run table in the layout the FA4 custom op consumes.

+    ``partial_*``/``full_*`` are the FlexAttention KV-block layout. The aux
+    tensors resolve pairs inside partial tiles and must be exactly as long as
+    the padded query/key streams (see ``_build_mask_mod``).
+    """

+    partial_counts: torch.Tensor
+    partial_indices: torch.Tensor
+    full_counts: torch.Tensor

+    k_group_ids: torch.Tensor

+def _build_mask_mod(cutlass, cute, fa_utils):
+    """Multiview mask_mod over the packed run truth table.

+    ``aux_tensors`` are, in order:
+
+    * ``q_word_base`` ``(seqlen_q,)`` int32: ``q_run * words_per_row``.
+    * ``k_group_ids`` ``(seqlen_k,)`` int32: the key token's run id.
+    * ``allowed_words`` ``(q_runs * words_per_row,)`` int32: the truth table
+      over run pairs, bit-packed 32 keys per word.

+    FA4 wraps the indices modulo ``seqlen_q``/``seqlen_k`` before calling a
+    mask_mod that has aux tensors, so reads on out-of-range padded lanes stay
+    in bounds; those lanes are force-masked afterwards. That holds only while
+    the aux tensors are exactly ``seqlen_q``/``seqlen_k`` long, which
+    ``multiview_fa4_attention`` checks.

+        seqlen_info: Any,

+
+
+def fa4_block_sparse_attention(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    sparsity: Fa4BlockSparsity,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run FA4 over contiguous ``[B, S, H, D]`` tensors with a block-sparse mask.
+
+    ``softmax_scale`` is left to FA4's default of ``1/sqrt(head_dim)``, which is
+    also the FlexAttention default the Triton paths rely on. Validation stays
+    outside the custom op so shape errors name this function rather than a
+    schema mismatch.
+    """
+    _validate_tensors(q, k, v)
+    # FA4 wraps aux reads modulo these lengths; a shorter tensor would alias.
+    if q.shape[1] != sparsity.q_word_base.numel():
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 FA4 padded query length must match the block map: "
+            f"q={q.shape[1]}, q_word_base={sparsity.q_word_base.numel()}."
+        )
+    if k.shape[1] != sparsity.k_group_ids.numel():
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 FA4 padded key length must match the block map: "
+            f"k={k.shape[1]}, k_group_ids={sparsity.k_group_ids.numel()}."
+        )
+    expected = fa4_sparse_block_sizes(q.device)
+    if (sparsity.q_block_size, sparsity.kv_block_size) != expected:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Cosmos3 FA4 requires a {expected} sparse block map on compute "
+            f"capability {torch.cuda.get_device_capability(q.device)[0]}.x, got "
+            f"({sparsity.q_block_size}, {sparsity.kv_block_size})."
+        )
+    return _cosmos3_multiview_fa4_op(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        sparsity.partial_counts,
+        sparsity.partial_indices,
+        sparsity.full_counts,
+        sparsity.full_indices,
+        sparsity.q_word_base,
+        sparsity.k_group_ids,
+        sparsity.allowed_words,
+        sparsity.q_block_size,
+        sparsity.kv_block_size,
+    )
+
+
+def multiview_fa4_attention(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    sparsity: MultiviewBlockSparsity,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FA4 over the Transfer-Auto ``[UND | GEN]`` stream with its multiview block map."""
+    if q.shape[1] != sparsity.q_len or k.shape[1] != sparsity.kv_len:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Cosmos3 multiview FA4 padded geometry must match the block map: "
+            f"q={q.shape[1]}, k={k.shape[1]}, mask=({sparsity.q_len}, {sparsity.kv_len})."
+        )
+    return fa4_block_sparse_attention(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        sparsity=Fa4BlockSparsity(
+            partial_counts=sparsity.partial_counts,
+            partial_indices=sparsity.partial_indices,
+            full_counts=sparsity.full_counts,
+            full_indices=sparsity.full_indices,
+            q_word_base=sparsity.q_word_base,
+            k_group_ids=sparsity.k_group_ids,
+            allowed_words=sparsity.allowed_words,
+            q_block_size=sparsity.q_block_size,
+            kv_block_size=sparsity.kv_block_size,
+        ),
+    )
